sections.body: Filters of sand and gravel — or modern membranes — catch what settling missed. Backwashing periodically cleans the media. Filtration is the barrier that makes disinfection reliable.

record_text:
Key points.
Filtration. Water passes through sand, gravel, or membranes to trap remaining particles.

In depth.
Filters of sand and gravel — or modern membranes — catch what settling missed. Backwashing periodically cleans the media. Filtration is the barrier that makes disinfection reliable.
